variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders the pronoun as a plain second-person feminine subject, 'about which thou didst utter a curse, and didst also speak it in mine ears'. Both candidates carry that same sense: the qere ואת and the ketiv ואתי are the short and the long (paragogic-yod) spellings of the second-person feminine singular pronoun, and neither spelling changes person, number, or gender, so the English wording cannot distinguish them. The only note on the verse, 'Or, an adjuration', is classed alternative_rendering and concerns the English word for the curse rather than this pronoun, so it decides nothing here. Underdetermined; the qere base fallback carries the projection.
